writing_turn.answer:
[writing-specialist]

# Growing Together: Saturday's Community Tomato-Planting Workshop

Spring is in the air, and your neighbors are getting ready to grow! Join us this Saturday for a hands-on community tomato-planting workshop at the Maplewood Community Garden.

Whether you've never held a seedling or your tomatoes never quite survived last summer, this workshop is for you. Our volunteer master gardeners will walk you through choosing healthy starts, hardening them off, spacing, staking, watering, and the first weeks of feeding. We'll cover which varieties thrive on our street's sun exposure, how to avoid the wilting and blight that frustrated so many of us, and when to plant so roots establish before the heat sets in.

Bring a hat and gloves; we'll provide plants, tools, soil, and lemonade. Come for an hour or stay for the whole morning and help us turn the shared beds into a summer-long harvest. Kids and beginners are especially welcome, and no green thumb is required. Come for an hour or stay for the whole morning and help us turn the shared beds into a summer-long harvest. Kids and beginners are especially welcome, and no green thumb is required.

Spots are limited, so please RSVP by Thursday at the community center, and remember to wear closed-toe shoes and a hat.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
